run_replace_fake_images: run the script to replace all images in a fake directory with compressed uniform-color versions
rewrite_image: rewrite an image file to a deterministic uniform color and save it with optimization
rewrite_zip: rewrite a zip archive by extracting, compressing images, and re-zipping with best compression
rewrite_tar: rewrite a tar archive by extracting, compressing images, and re-tarring with best compression
rewrite_dir: process a directory recursively to replace images and re-compress zip and tar archives
